scenarios.scenario_abstract: While managing back and tailbone pain, [X] needs a lower-body layer for gentle walking, cat-cow, knee-to-chest work, bird-dog, supported sitting, and careful sit-to-stand transitions; its amount of give must permit the prescribed range without bunching or shifting pressure toward the painful area.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在应对背部和尾骨疼痛期间，[X]需要一件下装完成轻缓步行、猫牛式、抱膝、鸟狗式、辅助坐姿和谨慎的坐站转换。面料的延展程度既要允许这些动作，又不能堆皱或把压力转移到疼痛区域。
examples: using No Stretch when a stable loose cut already permits the gentle routine without pressure migration
choosing Slight Stretch when floor transitions need controlled accommodation without cling
using High Stretch when the full mobility sequence requires broad range and the fabric still stays in place

scenarios.scenario_abstract: As [X] begins a three-day gym split, one lower-body option must cover deep squats, Romanian deadlifts, split squats, leg press, treadmill or cycling warm-ups, and rest between sets without trading all structure for mobility.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始每周三天的健身计划时，[X]需要一种下装同时应对深蹲、罗马尼亚硬拉、保加利亚分腿蹲、腿举、跑步机或骑行热身和组间休息，并在活动度与结构支撑之间取得平衡。
examples: using No Stretch when a roomy cut and stable fabric support controlled lifting
choosing Slight Stretch when the knees and hips need measured give across mixed exercises
using High Stretch when deep unilateral work and cardio range dominate but waist and knee recovery remain reliable

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After choosing home mat Pilates to counter long periods of sitting, [X] rotates short posture sessions, full-body flows, and light recovery days instead of repeating one workout at the same intensity. The lower layer is judged across rolling, side-lying work, bridges, twists, and repeated weekly use, with enough give for position changes but enough recovery and shape stability to avoid constant readjustment.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为缓解长时间坐着带来的影响，[X]选择在家做垫上 Pilates，并在短时姿态练习、全身流程和轻量恢复日之间轮换，而不是每天以同一强度重复；下装会在翻滚、侧卧动作、桥式、扭转和每周反复使用中受到检验，既要为姿势切换留出延展，又要能恢复形状、避免不断整理。
examples: using Slight Stretch when controlled mat transitions need modest give and reliable shape recovery
using High Stretch when the chosen flows repeatedly combine deep hip angles, rolling, and side-lying range
using No Stretch only when cut-based room supports the exact gentle sequence without pulling or readjustment

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While learning yoga through a thirty-minute stress-relief routine, [X] moves through seated breathing, cat-cow, child's pose, downward dog, a standing fold, lunges, balance, bridge, and a final supine twist, so the lower layer must support both stillness and large changes in hip and knee angle.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在通过 30 分钟练习学习瑜伽并缓解压力时，[X]会依次完成坐姿呼吸、猫牛式、婴儿式、下犬式、站立前屈、弓步、平衡、桥式和仰卧扭转。下装既要适合静止停留，也要应对髋膝角度的大幅变化。
examples: using No Stretch when a loose stable construction permits the gentle sequence without sliding
choosing Slight Stretch for slow transitions and grounded balance
using High Stretch when deep folds and lunges need unrestricted range while the waistband remains fixed

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When choosing trousers for an upcoming managerial interview, [X] needs the lower half to hold a crisp business line with a tucked shirt and jacket while still allowing a natural seated posture, standing introductions, and calm movement without looking like athletic wear.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为即将到来的管理岗位面试选择长裤时，[X]需要下装配合塞腰衬衫和外套维持利落商务线条，同时允许自然坐姿、起身介绍和从容走动，又不能显得像运动服。
examples: using No Stretch when tailoring and cut already provide enough seated ease
choosing Slight Stretch when discreet movement accommodation helps the formal trousers stay composed
using High Stretch only when its recovery and surface still read as business professional rather than activewear

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning an R&B stadium outfit, [X] compares cargo or parachute pants, biker shorts, relaxed jeans, and a tracksuit for long approaches, stairs, hard seats, dancing, heat, and secure phone and key storage; the lower layer's give must enable movement without letting loaded pockets distort it.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在规划 R&B 体育场演唱会穿搭时，[X]需要在工装裤或降落伞裤、骑行短裤、宽松牛仔裤和运动套装之间选择，以应对长距离步行、楼梯、硬座、舞动、热感以及手机和钥匙的安全收纳。下装的弹性既要支持活动，又不能让负重口袋把衣物拉变形。
examples: using No Stretch when a relaxed cut supplies dance room and loaded pockets need firm structure
choosing Slight Stretch when seated comfort and movement require controlled give
using High Stretch when continuous dancing dominates and the fabric still recovers under stored-item weight

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a week at a safe forest campsite, [X] needs quick-dry hiking or convertible pants for trail walking, crouching around a tent and stove, sitting at camp, and layering over thermal bottoms; the useful amount of give depends on the cut, mobility needs, and close layering.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备在安全的森林营地住一周时，[X]需要快干徒步裤或可拆卸裤应对林道行走、在帐篷和炉具旁蹲下、营地久坐以及叠穿保暖打底。合适的弹性程度取决于活动空间主要由版型、面料延展还是贴身叠层来承担。
examples: using No Stretch when articulated or roomy hiking pants provide movement and resist snagging
choosing Slight Stretch for repeated crouching and ordinary trail steps
using High Stretch for large scrambling range or a close base layer beneath waterproof pants

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a long-distance move made mostly by public transport, [X] limits clothing to two bottoms and wears the bulkier pieces in transit; the travel-day option must tolerate walking with two bags, steps, lifting, prolonged sitting, and repeated transfers while remaining stable around documents and other close-carried items.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 依靠公共交通长途搬家时，[X]只带两件下装，并在途中穿上较厚重的衣物。旅行日下装需要应对提着两个包行走、上下台阶、搬抬、长时间坐乘和多次换乘，同时还要在贴身携带证件等物品时保持稳定。
examples: using No Stretch when a roomy travel cut and firm waistband control the load
choosing Slight Stretch when sitting and lifting need discreet accommodation without sagging
using High Stretch when repeated transfers require maximum range and the fabric reliably returns under bag contact

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a casual afternoon campus reunion, [X] proposes familiar dark jeans with a sweater and classic clogs, then judges whether that exact pair allows enough movement for walking between buildings and sitting through long conversations without losing the clean, slightly polished shape [X] wants.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备参加下午的校园同学聚会时，[X]打算穿熟悉的深色牛仔裤、毛衣和经典洞洞鞋，并判断这条具体牛仔裤是否有足够的活动余量应对楼间步行和久坐聊天，同时不失去[X]想要的干净、稍显利落的轮廓。
examples: keeping No Stretch when the familiar jeans' cut already supports the reunion activities
preferring Slight Stretch when seated ease is needed without changing the denim look
using High Stretch only when the exact jeans retain a clean shape rather than reading as soft activewear

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While assembling a personal Tracer cosplay, [X] chooses dark athletic leggings to sit beneath a utility belt, thigh holsters, a cropped bomber jacket, and boots; the leggings must stretch through energetic character poses without shifting the attached costume details out of position.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在制作个人 Tracer cosplay 时，[X]选择深色运动打底裤，并在外面叠加工装腰带、大腿枪套、短款飞行夹克和靴子。打底裤的弹性需要支持角色的活跃姿势和多层装配，同时不能让附加的装饰结构偏离位置。
examples: using No Stretch only when the leggings' shaped cut still permits the intended poses
choosing Slight Stretch when moderate give helps support belt and holster alignment
using High Stretch when energetic movement needs broad range and recovery prevents the costume layers from drifting

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A bicycle courier who skateboards after work needs lower-body clothing that can move from hours of repetitive seated pedaling to explosive, asymmetrical board movement while preserving knee comfort, cooling, and secure storage across both activities.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名自行车配送员下班后还要滑板，需要下装从数小时重复坐姿踩踏切换到爆发性、非对称的板上动作，同时兼顾膝部舒适、散热和两种活动中的安全收纳。
